alana_cs: HaloAI demo tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need EU region allowlist + temp rate lift for demo traffic. Also they pinned a custom header (X-Halo-Auth) and want mTLS later — can we do header exemption + short RL increase? :pray:

 tia_support: Got it. What IP ranges and target qps for the demo?

 alana_cs: IPs they sent: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25, 45.55.66.0/24. Target: burst 2k qps for a 2-hour window starting 10:00 UTC. Auto-revoke after 3h.

 jake_ops: I can provision EU edge allowlist + temp RL. Will we want header bypass for rate limiter (for X-Halo-Auth) or an origin-level allowlist?

 sam_engineer: Recommend header bypass + origin CIDR allowlist. Add this to route config:

 ```json
 {
   "route": "/v1/generate",
   "allowlist_cidrs": ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25","45.55.66.0/24"],
   "rate_limit_override": {"qps":2000, "duration":7200}
 }
 ```

 sam_engineer: Also note: if they use long-running chat sessions we'll need KV cache warmup — pre-warm is recommended.

 jake_ops: Creating internal ticket and will apply. Ticket: CS-98721. Applying allowlist to eu-edge-1 and eu-edge-2, setting RL override to 2000 qps, expiry 2024-10-12T12:00:00Z. Adding header exemption for `X-Halo-Auth` on /v1/generate. Will monitor.

 sre-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for cs-perms (ID: deploy-3344). Status: success ✅

 ella_platform: Add billing note and renewal flag please — this customer is on a trial with high demo usage, flagged renewal risk. @margo_am can you follow up post-demo?

 margo_am: On it. I'll schedule a 1:1 + send enablement checklist. Flagging renewal risk: medium. Capture demo metrics and signal if sustained >500 qps for 7 days.

 jake_ops: Done. Applied config, set auto-revoke job, and added monitor: `cs.haloai.demo.qps` alert at 1200 qps sustained 5m. Ticket CS-98721 closed with note.

 alana_cs: Amazing, thank you team :rocket: Please ping if anything spikes during demo.

 sam_engineer: I'll watch KV hit rate and warm caches at +5min before start.

 sre-bot: Monitor check-in scheduled at 10:05 UTC. Good luck! :crossed_fingers:
